BillHeading.BriefDescription: Allowing ultrasounds prior to terminating a pregnancy.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing ultrasounds prior to terminating a pregnancy; and amending RCW 9.02.110.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 9.02.110 and 2022 c 65 s 3 are each amended to read as follows:Right to have and provide.
BillSection.P: (1) The state may not deny or interfere with a pregnant individual's right to choose to have an abortion prior to viability of the fetus, or to protect the pregnant individual's life or health.

(2) A physician, physician assistant, advanced registered nurse practitioner, or other health care provider acting within the provider's scope of practice may terminate and a health care provider may assist a physician, physician assistant, advanced registered nurse practitioner, or other health care provider acting within the provider's scope of practice in terminating a pregnancy as permitted by this section.

P.TextRun: (3) If an ultrasound is used prior to any abortion, the physician, physician assistant, advanced registered nurse practitioner, or other health care provider or an agent of a health care provider acting within the provider's scope of practice may offer a pregnant individual the ability to see the ultrasound prior to the termination of the individual's pregnancy.

BillSection.History: 2022 c 65 § 3; 1992 c 1 § 2 (Initiative Measure No. 120, approved November 5, 1991).

AnnNote.NoteP: Legislative affirmation—2022 c 65: See note following RCW 9.02.100.
